questions.prompt: The city was being fortified by the soldiers while the enemy approached.
questions.answer: Urbs ā mīlitibus mūniēbātur dum hostēs appropinquant.

questions.prompt: The prisoners are bound with heavy chains in the dark prison.
questions.answer: Captīvī gravibus catēnīs in carcere obscūrō vinciuntur.

questions.prompt: You are heard by all, when you speak with wisdom.
questions.answer: Ab omnibus audīris, cum sapienter loqueris.

questions.prompt: The gates of the temple were being opened at dawn by the priests.
questions.answer: Templī portae prīmā lūce ā sacerdōtibus aperiēbantur.

questions.prompt: You will be heard by the king, if you speak truthfully.
questions.answer: Ā rēge audiēris, sī vērē dīcēs.

questions.prompt: The wounded man will be guarded through the whole night.
questions.answer: Vir vulnerātus tōtam per noctem custōdiētur.

questions.prompt: These crimes will be punished by the just judge.
questions.answer: Haec scelera ā iūdice iūstō pūnientur.

questions.prompt: The soldiers had been heard by the general before the battle.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs ā duce ante proelium audītī erant.

questions.prompt: The city has been fortified with a strong wall and a deep ditch.
questions.answer: Urbs validō mūrō et altā fossā mūnīta est.

questions.prompt: The old king was buried with great honor in the ancestral tomb.
questions.answer: Rēx senex magnō honōre in sepulcrō patriō sepultus est.

questions.prompt: The gates had been opened by the traitor during the night.
questions.answer: Portae ā prōditōre per noctem apertae erant.

questions.prompt: The leader ordered that the camp be fortified before dawn.
questions.answer: Dux imperāvit ut castra ante lūcem mūnīrentur.

questions.prompt: Let the guilty be punished, but let the innocent be released.
questions.answer: Nocentēs pūniantur, sed innocentēs expediantur.

questions.prompt: They fought bravely so that the walls might not be opened to the enemy.
questions.answer: Fortiter pugnāvērunt nē moenia hostī aperīrentur.

questions.prompt: I fear that our plans are being heard by spies.
questions.answer: Vereor nē cōnsilia nostra ab explōrātōribus audiantur.

questions.prompt: The child is nourished with milk by his mother.
questions.answer: Īnfāns lacte ā mātre nūtrītur.

questions.prompt: The young men were being educated in the liberal arts.
questions.answer: Iuvenēs līberālibus artibus ērudiēbantur.

questions.prompt: The wine was seasoned with honey and set before the guests.
questions.answer: Vīnum melle condītum est et hospitibus appositum est.

questions.prompt: The deep well was drained by the thirsty travelers.
questions.answer: Altus puteus ā sitientibus viātōribus haustus est.

questions.prompt: The town could not be fortified in a single day.
questions.answer: Oppidum ūnō diē mūnīrī nōn poterat.

questions.prompt: Be heard, citizens, and your rights will be defended.
questions.answer: Audīminī, cīvēs, et iūra vestra dēfendentur.

questions.prompt: It was reported that the enemy's camp had been fortified during the night.
questions.answer: Nūntiātum est hostium castra nocte mūnīta esse.
